slides.title: 3 buy orders. Where does each one fill?
Market order: fills now
slides.text: Fills **immediately** at the best price available. Fast, but the price is **not guaranteed**.

slides.title: Buy limit: below the price
slides.text: You wait for a **better price**. Here it came. If it never comes, **no fill**.

slides.title: Buy stop: above the price
slides.text: Used for **breakouts** and **stop losses**. It becomes a market order, so it can **slip**.

points.b: A stop that becomes a limit order
points.t: You cap the worst price you accept.

points.b: In a fast move it can be skipped
points.t: Price jumps past your limit: no fill.

points.b: So don't use it as a stop loss
points.t: That's exactly when you need to be out.

slides.title: Your stop loss should be a stop order.
slides.text: Limit to get a better price. Stop to get **out, no matter what**.
